claims.object_text: synaptic GTPase-activating protein (GAP) critical for synaptic plasticity, learning, memory, and cognition
claims.quote: SynGAP is an abundant synaptic GTPase-activating protein (GAP) critical for synaptic plasticity, learning, memory, and cognition.
Mutations in SYNGAP1 in humans result in intellectual disability, autistic-like behaviors, and epilepsy.

claims.object_text: competes with the AMPA-receptor-TARP excitatory receptor complex to form molecular condensates with synaptic scaffolding proteins
claims.quote: SynGAP modulates synaptic strength by physically competing with the AMPA-receptor-TARP excitatory receptor complex in the formation of molecular condensates with synaptic scaffolding proteins.
